task: Red Team Inquisition & Self-Fixing: Waitlist, Hot Slots & Downtime Dispatcher
completed_steps: Read all mandatory authority files: core.md, frontend.md, engineering.md, THE_HAMMER_MASTER_PROMPT.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md completely

Reconnaissance: Located backend routes (waitlist.ts, waitlistMatches.ts, appointments.ts), schema (schedule.ts), matching services (waitlistMatching.ts, smartGapFillerService.ts), frontend engines and drawers (WaitlistDrawer.tsx, useWaitlistDrawerOperations.ts, FreedSlotsPanel.tsx, WaitlistMatchesBlock.tsx, WaitlistQuickFillModal.tsx, waitlistCancellationEngine.ts)
Identified Defect #1: Silent omission of default status: 'waiting' entries in GET /api/waitlist (only filtered by 'active', dropping newly created or migrated records)

Identified Defect #2: Disconnected Smart Gap-Filler daemon with silent error swallowing (catch { return null; }), incomplete priority scoring and absence of weekday/time-range validation against patient preferences

Identified Defect #3: Concurrency race condition on 1-click slot filling (multiple receptionists simultaneously attempting to take the same freed slot without optimistic status check, risking silent patient overwrite)
Identified Defect #4: WaitlistQuickFillModal hardcoding allowOverbooking: true and attempting duplicate POST instead of PATCHing cancelled appointmentId with expectedCurrentStatus
Identified Defect #5: Modal matryoshka in AppointmentModal.tsx stacking two full-screen modal overlays (AppointmentModal + WaitlistDrawer) simultaneously
Identified Defect #6: Redundant competing modal mounts in ScheduleViewModals.tsx (both WaitlistDrawer and WaitlistQuickFillModal mounted for the same slot)
Identified Defect #7: Missing chair & doctor fallback in useWaitlistDrawerOperations.ts leading to 400 Bad Request in solo doctor / 1-chair clinics (Mandate 8n)
Identified Defect #8: Invalid UUID fallback 'pat-wait-${Date.now()}' on quick patient creation failure in useWaitlistDrawerOperations.ts violating PostgreSQL schema constraints
Self-fixed Defect #1: Updated apps/api/src/routes/waitlist.ts to query inArray(status, ['active', 'waiting']) and allow waiting/cancelled in PUT/PATCH schemas

Self-fixed Defect #2: Hardened smartGapFillerService.ts with parsePreferredRanges, slotFitsRanges, parsePreferredWeekday, clinical priority weights (urgent/pain=100, high=80, plan=75, medium=50, low=25), and logged errors with console.error; connected triggerSmartGapFiller on appointment cancellation in appointments.ts with HOT_SLOT_FREED websocket broadcast

Self-fixed Defect #3: Added expectedCurrentStatus to updateAppointmentSchema in @dental/shared, enforced optimistic concurrency in updateAppointmentInDb and in-memory sampleData, returning structured HTTP 409 conflict when a freed slot is already claimed

Self-fixed Defect #4: Updated useWaitlistDrawerOperations.ts, WaitlistMatchesBlock.tsx, and WaitlistQuickFillModal.tsx to pass expectedCurrentStatus: ['cancelled', 'no_show'] on 1-click booking into freed windows
Self-fixed Defect #5: Eliminated modal matryoshka in AppointmentModal.tsx by transitioning directly to WaitlistDrawer without rendering underlying cancelled appointment dialog
Self-fixed Defect #6: Consolidated ScheduleViewModals.tsx on WaitlistDrawer as SSOT (isOpen={waitlistOpen || waitlistQuickFillSlot !== null}), eliminating duplicate modal mount
Self-fixed Defect #7: Added DEFAULT_SOLO_CHAIR and active staff doctor fallbacks in useWaitlistDrawerOperations.ts ensuring 100% solo doctor autonomy (Mandate 8n)
Self-fixed Defect #8: Replaced invalid UUID string fallback with explicit error toast and safe return in useWaitlistDrawerOperations.ts
Fixed SSR safety issue in InventoryConfirmDialog.tsx by importing React
Created automated unit test apps/api/src/tests/waitlistConcurrency.test.ts verifying race condition prevention and conflict error rejection

Ran verification: check-encoding (7213 files clean), check-css-tokens (165 css files clean, 0 unresolved), and all targeted unit tests (waitlistMatching, waitlistConcurrency, waitlistCancellation, WaitlistQuickFillModal, modalPortalsSsrSafety, soloDoctorScheduleAutonomy: 50/50 passing with 0 failures)

findings.description: GET /api/waitlist dropped all entries with default status 'waiting' because of eq(status, 'active')
Two receptionists booking the same freed window could overwrite each other without optimistic concurrency lock
smartGapFillerService was never invoked on appointment cancellation, swallowed errors silently, and lacked weekday/time matching
WaitlistQuickFillModal hardcoded allowOverbooking: true and ignored appointmentId, creating conflicting duplicate appointments
AppointmentModal.tsx rendered both modalContent and WaitlistDrawer simultaneously, creating double backdrops and trapping user in cancelled modal on dismiss
ScheduleViewModals.tsx mounted both WaitlistDrawer and WaitlistQuickFillModal for the same freed slot, violating SSOT
useWaitlistDrawerOperations.ts failed with 400 Bad Request when booking slot without explicit doctor or chair in solo practice
useWaitlistDrawerOperations.ts caught patient creation errors and assigned pat-wait-${Date.now()} violating PostgreSQL UUID foreign key constraint
